{{short description|Physicist}}
'''Claudia Draxl''' is a physicist and academic.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.academia-net.org/profil/prof-dr-dr-h-c-claudia-draxl/1144392|title=Prof. Dr. Dr. h.c. Claudia Draxl – AcademiaNet|website=www.academia-net.org|access-date=2018-12-29}}</ref> She is a full professor at the [[Humboldt University of Berlin]] in theoretical [[condensed matter physics]].

== Life ==
From 1978 to 1983, Draxl studied mathematics and physics at the [[University of Graz]].<ref name=":0" /> She received her doctorate at the University of Graz in theoretical physics in 1987.<ref name=":0" /> She finished her habilitation at University of Graz in 1996.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://science-match.tagesspiegel.de/claudia-draxl|title=Claudia Draxl|website=science-match.tagesspiegel.de|language=en|access-date=2018-12-29}}{{Dead link|date=November 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> From 1996 to 1997, she was a lecturer at the University of Graz.<ref name=":0" /> From 1997 to 1998, she was an associate professor at the University of Graz.<ref name=":0" /> She was the director of the Institute of Theoretical Physics at the University of Graz from 1999 to 2001, and the deputy director of the very same institute from 2001 to 2004.<ref name=":0" /> From 2005 to 2011, she was a university professor at the [[University of Leoben]] and had the chair for Atomistic Modelling and Design of Materials.<ref name=":0" /> Since 2011, she is a university professor at the [[Humboldt University of Berlin]] and has the chair of theoretical condensed matter physics.<ref name=":0" />

== Research ==
Draxl's research focuses on condensed matter theory and [[computational materials science]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=September 6, 2025 |title=Prof. Claudia Draxl - FONDA – Foundations of Workflows for Large-Scale Scientific Data Analysis |url=https://fonda.hu-berlin.de/?page_id=54}}</ref> Her main research topics are:<ref name=":0" />

*''Ab initio'' calculation of the properties of solids
* Density functional theory
* Many-body theory
* Theoretical spectroscopy
* Electron-phonon coupling
* Organic and inorganic semiconductors
* Hybrid materials & nanostructures
* Superconductivity

== Awards ==
Draxl has received several awards:

*[[Ludwig Boltzmann Prize]] from the [[Austrian Physical Society]] (OePG) in 1995<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.sbpmat.org.br//14encontro/plenary-speakers/Bio-Claudia.pdf|title=Bio Draxl|website=www.sbpmat.org.br|access-date=2018-12-29}}</ref><ref name=":1" />
*Honorary doctorate from the Faculty of Science and Technology at Uppsala University, Sweden, in 2000<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":1" />
* Research award from the Federal State of Styria, Austria, in 2008<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":1" />
* Fellow of the [[American Physical Society]] in 2011<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":1" />
* Einstein Professor at the Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin in 2013<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.einsteinfoundation.de/personen-projekte/einstein-professoren/claudia-draxl/|title=Claudia Draxl – Einstein Stiftung Berlin|website=www.einsteinfoundation.de|access-date=2018-12-30}}</ref><ref name=":2" /><ref name=":1" />
* Paracelsusring by the City of [[Villach]] in 2013<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.villach.at/stadt-erleben/ueber-villach/preistraeger-und-ehrenbuerger|title=Preisträger und Ehrenbürger Villach|language=German|access-date=30 December 2018}}</ref><ref name=":2" /><ref name=":1" />
* Caroline von Humboldt Professorship in 2014<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://idw-online.de/de/news564076|title=HU-Physikerin Claudia Draxl wird Caroline-von-Humboldt-Professorin 2014|website=idw-online.de|access-date=2018-12-29}}</ref><ref name=":1" />
* Appointment as a Max Planck Fellow in 2014<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":1" />
* Corresponding member of the [[Austrian Academy of Sciences]] abroad in 2018<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.oeaw.ac.at/m/draxl-claudia/|title=ÖAW Mitglieder Detail|website=www.oeaw.ac.at|access-date=2018-12-29}}</ref>
